content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform in late cycles.", "Sentiment peaks correlate with forecast overshoots, suggesting sentiment drives short-term price spikes.", "Model bias toward mean reversion is evident when true prices dip below forecast midpoints.", "Forecast lags in high-sentiment periods, indicating delayed reaction to sentiment shifts.", "True prices often diverge from forecasts during low-sentiment windows, signaling model underfitting.", "Model accuracy improves when sentiment aligns with recent price trends, suggesting sentiment calibration is critical.", "Forecast decay is steeper in high-sentiment periods, indicating sentiment amplifies volatility.", "Sentiment-driven corrections are frequently missed by models, leading to persistent forecast errors."]}
